explanation: The third king of Israel, known for his wisdom and the building of the temple in Jerusalem.
King of Tyre, who helped Solomon obtain materials and craftsmen for the construction of the temple.
Large, valuable trees from Lebanon, used in the building of the temple and other structures in Israel.
The process of constructing or assembling a building, in this case the temple.
A holy place for worship and sacrifices, built by Solomon in Jerusalem as a house for God's name.
People who work on a specific task; here it refers to those who worked on the temple.
Places where stone is extracted from the ground, used as building material for the temple.
